data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal 6-frame sprite strip for the Codex app digital pet "tracebun" in the state "running". Use the attached pet reference as the canonical identity and the attached layout guide only for frame count, spacing, centering, and safe padding. Important: final canvas must be edge-to-edge flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no other background colors, no white, no off-white, no gray, no checkerboard, no guide boxes, no borders, no labels, no dividers, no slot lines, and no layout artifacts visible at all.

Sprite requirements: 6 separate frames arranged left-to-right in one row, each frame fully contained and centered with consistent scale. Keep the same pet identity exactly: a compact observability guardian rabbit, warm brown and cream palette, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark outline, small floppy ears, calm focused eyes, tiny service badge on the chest, reliable engineer energy. Preserve head shape, ear shape, body proportions, markings, prop/accessory design, and outline weight from the canonical base pet. Do not redesign the pet.

Action: running. Make the cycle distinct and readable while subtle and identity-preserving. Use a classic running loop with slight body bob, alternating forelegs and hindlegs, small ear bounce, and tiny motion variation across the 6 frames. Keep one complete pose per slot; no cropping, no overlap across frame boundaries, no pose crossing between slots. The pet should remain front-facing / near-front-facing and clearly recognizable in every frame. Simplify details into a clean pixel-art digital pet sprite style. No text. No extra objects. No shadows outside the pet. No props changing identity.
